tools.name: grafana_platform_service_health
tools.description: Aggregated service health across platform dashboards.

tools.name: grafana_queue_backlog
tools.description: RabbitMQ queue backlog with total and per-queue breakdown.

tools.name: grafana_queue_trend
tools.description: RabbitMQ queue backlog trend over a bounded time range.

tools.name: grafana_throughput
tools.description: RabbitMQ publish, ack, and lag rates.

tools.name: grafana_http_health
tools.description: HTTP request rate, error rate, and p95 latency.

tools.name: grafana_java_errors
tools.description: Java service error rate from span metrics when available.

tools.name: grafana_trace_metrics
tools.description: Per-service call rate, error rate, and p95 latency from Tempo span metrics.

tools.name: grafana_logs
tools.description: Recent Loki warning/error logs across services or a filtered service.

tools.name: grafana_emqx_health
tools.description: EMQX connections, message rates, drop rate, auth/subscribe rates, and disconnect reasons.

tools.name: grafana_emqx_connection_trend

tools.name: grafana_k8s_health

tools.name: grafana_k8s_resources
tools.description: Kubernetes namespace, pod CPU/memory, restart count, pod status, and recent error summary.

tools.name: grafana_redis_health
tools.description: Redis connected clients, ops rate, hit rate, and memory.

tools.name: grafana_mongodb_health
tools.description: MongoDB instance availability and average latency.

tools.name: grafana_mysql_health
tools.description: MySQL availability, QPS, connected threads, slow queries, and level.

tools.name: grafana_linux_health
tools.description: Linux node CPU, memory, disk, and network receive rate.
